scope: Given finite connected periodic cubic torus L>=5, N=L^3, kappa=1/100, native coefficients a=1/12,b=1/24,c=1/576,M=4, epsilon_L=1/96. Entire physical Gauss space with N fermions. Marked plaquette p and edge e with p_e=1. Every beta>0 has normal finite-energy Gibbs state; exact limiting extension is necessarily nonnormal. Error uniform over individual affine monomials only; fixed sums pay coefficient l1 cost. Finite-time statement assumes effectively specified finite-support input and finite times; large computational cost allowed. No thermodynamic/continuum claim.
